about_the_game:
Step into the world of Zombeo & Vampireta, a visual novel that fuses the darkest humor with a touch of horror in a world where the dead find no rest… and neither does love!

Zombeo Muertesco, a zombie still searching for a purpose beyond devouring brains, falls in love with Vampiretta Sanguileto, a vampiress as seductive as she is dangerous.

But their families—the Muertesco and the Sanguileto—are locked in eternal war, and love between the two is far from welcome.

Explore Mortánima Cemetery, where chaos, secrets, and unexpected twists make every corner a new surprise.

Play as Zombeo or Vampiretta and face decisions that will shape your fate—and that of your undead loved ones. Every choice can lead you down a path of macabre laughs, impossible romance, and of course… a touch of terror!

Can you defy the rules of the afterlife and save your love in the middle of war?

Play and uncover all the endings Zombeo & Vampireta, has to offer! Get ready for a mix of horror, humor, and unexpected twists!

short_description: Zombeo y Vampireta is a short visual novel about impossible love and corpses full of life. Play as a romantic zombie or a foul-mouthed vampiress in a family feud fueled by centuries of resentment—and the stench of death. Discover how far a love story between two hopeful undead can go.
